approval_sequence: separate explicit approval for ONE sleep5 smoke transient service (approval_plan.json)
record real effective memory/pids/cpu files and cleanup; stop if any mismatch
separate explicit approval for bounded pressure/descendant/cleanup/fail-closed/Bubblewrap tests
fixture: own minimal Python/C fixture design only; no unreviewed executable, no DART/Gazebo; no pressure code executed
baseline_and_gate: record exact unit absence, UID and user-manager cgroup/controller baseline
get ControlGroup from manager; verify dedicated fresh task path and exact memory.max/pids.max/cpu.max before pressure
read memory.swap.max, memory.events, pids.events, cpu.stat and cgroup.events baseline
refuse missing values/wrong cgroup or parent-only limits; no fallback to RLIMIT
verify fixture/child/grandchild membership in same unit cgroup; never migrate existing user jobs

tests.case: try at most16 total child/task creation operations, each owned child sleeps briefly; include one grandchild
tests.success: pids.current within12 and pids.events max increment + EAGAIN; tasks count includes threads; wait all

tests.success: cpu.max readback25000 100000 and cpu.stat throttled delta; report scheduling uncertainty; quota throttles rather than kills

tests.case: fixture creates child and grandchild only after gate; record host PID/PPid/start/cgroup membership
tests.success: all own identities remain in same limited unit subtree

tests.case: normal/timeout/own supervisor death; stop only exact owned service if necessary
tests.success: cgroup.events populated0 + owned identities gone + unit removed/collected; preserve errors; no unrelated kill

evidence: fixture/source/build hash if built; exact approved scope and unit ID
effective files and before/after event counters, selected properties only
bounded stdout/stderr, exit/signal/OOM/throttle, owned process identities
read-only original-file/main baseline before/after; no full env or credentials
cleanup: stop own exact unit only; wait/reap own children, retain logs; never globally disable controllers or move other tasks
limit_change_policy: no auto relaxation, retries or destructive OOM outside task unit; stop if actual side effects exceed approval
